entries.title: Announcing Our Fall Issue
entries.summary: “But I did feel, as we worked on this one, that I was listening in on many voices whose speakers were attempting to locate themselves in what would become history before it hardened into narrative.”

entries.title: A Poem Is Full of Meat: Dorothea Lasky on Mother
entries.summary: “The terms ‘mother’ and ‘father’ have the same dominant energy as ‘God’ or ‘the Devil’ in a poem.”

entries.title: At the Conformation Show: Chasing the Ideal Dog
entries.summary: “Conformation shows measure the degree to which a dog ‘conforms’ to its ‘breed standard,’ a document that transmutes historical function into marketable qualities.”
